### How to Read This Dashboard

| Column | Meaning | Action |
|--------|---------|--------|
| **Current** (Orange) | What you're paying now | - |
| **Optimized** (Blue) | Cost after applying VPA recommendations | - |
| **Savings** (Green) | Money you can save monthly | Higher = prioritize |
| **Over-Provisioned** | Using less than requested | Safe to reduce |
| **Under-Provisioned** (Red) | At risk - needs MORE resources | Fix immediately |

**Click any namespace** in the table to drill down to workload-level details.
